_comment: SNIPPET — merge these three entries into your host vercel.json `headers` array. Order matters: a per-path entry overrides the global wildcard for that path. PLAYBOOK §H/§I/§J.
_globalAdjustments: Also in your existing global '/(.*)' rule: set X-Frame-Options to SAMEORIGIN (not DENY) and CSP frame-ancestors to 'self' (not 'none'). Otherwise even same-origin framing is blocked.

headers._why: PLAYBOOK §I — relaxed COOP for the whole /palace tree. The outer 3D scene reads iframe state and forwards events; under strict COOP same-origin, Chrome treats same-origin frames as cross-origin for window-object access. unsafe-none stops the agent-cluster isolation. Rest of the site keeps strict global COOP.

PLAYBOOK §J — HTML entry for /palace is ~1.7KB; turning off caching for the document itself means security-header changes take effect on first reload after deploy. Asset files (bundle.*.js, models/, etc.) still cache normally.
Same as above, for the inner OS entry document.
